claim: For ephemeral compute, the FIRST success criterion is an evidence-branch push from inside the environment — before any deeper exec work; interactive channels are garnish.
evidence: 66-c died at turn-200 with oracle code on main (quilt-codespace cdcbefa7) but zero evidence branches; its sandbox lacked ssh/ssh-keygen entirely, so the finisher salvaged nothing from the worktree. The REST-only fallback (start → evidence-branch push via its own git credential → stop/delete) is the channel that survives lane death.
why: a push is the only action whose result outlives the process that performed it — every other channel 66-c had died with 66-c

pins.name: ls-remote shows the evidence branch within one boot cycle
